digest.component_or_area: RP-04 secrets and authentication architecture research
propositions: Rebar must support provider-native authentication and credential refresh for eight external providers (Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gerrit, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Jira Cloud/DC) across nine deployment contexts without a universal secret broker or weakening SDK-native credential chains
Current _bridge_runner propagates full parent environment including unrelated provider credentials to reconciler and ticket delivery children, violating adapter isolation
Deployment-resolved static secrets must rotate by restart/redeploy; no application-owned SSM retrieval, hot-reload watchers, or process-global environment mutation

Operation snapshots must remain structurally non-secret; provider-specific authentication is injected as native credentials/sessions into Rebar-owned factories, with unavoidable static values wrapped only in non-serializable containers excluded from snapshots/caches/serialization

Subprocess children inherit ambient environment for trusted same-capability use; unrelated siblings remove only exact Rebar-declared secret names while preserving native Git/SSH/AWS/proxy credential chains and unknown variables

Static operation-certificate signing accepts exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH (preferred) or multiline REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY; deployment resolves external stores before startup and Rebar binds signer context-locally without global os.environ mutation
